blocks.h2: Why Hanover Park Basements Back Up

tiles.body: Sewers under strain push water back.

blocks.intro: In the August 2007 storm, Hanover Park basements took water from sewer backups.

items.body: A backup on a dry day points to your line. One in heavy rain points to the sewer system.
Common in Hanover Park homes, and expensive to restore.
A backflow valve or [overhead sewer system](/hanover-park/overhead-sewer-systems) keeps sewer water out.

blocks.h2: What to Do After a Sewer Backup
blocks.body: Once the line is clear, take photos of the damage before anything is moved, then call your insurance agent to ask whether you have sewer backup coverage. Anything porous that touched sewage, like carpet, padding and cardboard, usually has to go. Hard surfaces can be cleaned and disinfected. A restoration company can dry the walls and floor properly. Keep our camera footage and invoice with your claim, because they show the cause and the repair.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Why did my basement back up on a sunny day?
items.answer: Without rain, the blockage is almost always in your own line: roots, a belly or a clog.

items.q: Do you clean up after a backup?
items.preview: We fix the plumbing. A restoration company cleans up.
items.answer: We clear the line and repair the cause. A restoration company handles cleanup and drying.

items.q: Is a sewer backup covered by insurance?
items.answer: Many policies need a sewer backup rider. Check with your agent.

items.q: How do I keep it from happening again?
items.preview: Fix the cause, then add protection.
items.answer: Fix what caused it, then consider a backflow valve or overhead sewer.

items.q: Is it safe to stay in the house?
items.preview: Usually, if you keep out of the basement.
items.answer: Usually, as long as everyone stays out of the affected area and the water isn't near electrical.

items.q: Can I use the upstairs bathroom?
items.preview: Not until the line is clear.
items.answer: Not until the line is clear. Upstairs water drains to the same place.

items.q: How much does sewer backup service cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused it and how we reach the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
